data.gender_notes: Devadutta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devadutta is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'deva' meaning 'god' and 'dutta' meaning 'gift'. It is believed to be a name given to a child who is considered a divine gift or a blessing from the gods. The name Devadutta carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devadutta usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
